title: Nostr profile settings route
observed_behavior: docs/designs/unified-user-menu.md defines an Edit Profile menu item for /settings/profile.
Before this slice, UserMenu linked Edit Profile to /settings because /settings/profile did not exist.
intended_behavior: Authenticated users can open /settings/profile from UserMenu or the Settings profile card.
The profile form edits Nostr kind-0 metadata fields and validates field lengths, URLs, NIP-05, and lightning address formats before signing.
Publishing signs the kind-0 event with the active auth signer flow, publishes to writable signer/NIP-65 relays, checks per-relay OK accepted outcomes, and reports rejection/failure details.
out_of_scope: Relay sidecar HTTP inventory documentation handled by the concurrent docs-only agent.
Changing Nostr event kind definitions; kind 0 is a standard Nostr metadata kind.
